card.name: Capital S starting a new word
card.fires_on: A lone capital S (or Greek sigma) that begins a new word right after a break, such as a hyphen, slash, space, or run-together heading, where the model expects an 'S' word like Suicidal, Sulfate or Senatorial.

modes.label: S after a joined heading
modes.description: The S starts a word run straight onto the previous word or slash.

modes.label: S in drug names
modes.description: The S starts the second part of a drug name, such as Sulfate, or follows a hyphen in a brand name.
modes.example: before increasing the Morphine<< S>>ulfate Oral Solution dosage.

modes.label: S after a sentence end or hyphen
modes.description: The S begins the next word in running text, split from the period or hyphen.
modes.example: financial matters of the Republic<<.S>>enatorial control was eventually challenged by Dict

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with 'sch'-type word starts, which is a weak and odd effect.
card.plain: It fires when a capital S starts a new word, such as the S of Sulfate or Suicidal.
